structure.why: RP2026 lacks four verses of the Received Text and places two passages otherwise. The build verifies each decision against the Greek ledger: a structural unit without its decision, or a decision without its unit, stops the build. An omitted verse's words become a note on the verse before it; a moved passage is noted at both its places.
